ui.intro: Your StarCraft journey starts here. Configure your game directory to get ready.
ui.telemetryHelp: Send error reports only with your consent. Disable at any time.
ui.unavailable: Self-update is unavailable in this environment
ui.desktopOnly: Desktop bridge unavailable. Use these settings in the Electron app.
campaign.title: Campaigns
campaign.statisticsHint: Totals use installation records for the current game directory, grouped by campaign and management format. Active copies, backups and untracked files are excluded; these totals are not actual disk usage.
campaign.dropHint: Drop one archive or folder here. Import first, then activate to install campaign maps.
campaign.empty: No campaigns here. Import a package or scan your game.
campaign.switchHint: Switching restores the current campaign before confirming the target activation. Active campaigns must be restored before uninstalling.
campaign.ccmWarning: CCM installs Mods during import. Deactivation and uninstall do not remove or restore these Mods.
campaign.removeConfirm: Confirm removal. CCM Mods are not managed by this operation.
campaign.oneSource: Analyze one archive or folder at a time.
campaign.overviewHint: Choose an installed package to manage your campaign experience.
campaign.author: Author
campaign.uninstallActiveHint: Confirm deactivation first, then confirm library removal.
campaign.dropClick: Drag in or click to select an {archive} / {folder} to install
campaign.activatePrompt: The campaign has been added to your library. Activate it now?
campaign.activationUnavailable: No activatable payload is available. Scan or check the installation source.
campaign.installingHint: Installing files. Do not close the application…
campaign.name: Name
campaign.modeUnavailable: This mode is not available or is not supported by the source.
campaign.switchConfirm: Switching first restores the current campaign, then asks you to confirm activation and file conflicts for the target campaign.
campaign.activateConfirm: Activate this campaign? Activation writes game maps and related mods.
campaign.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall this campaign? Its installed library content will be removed.
campaign.restoreConfirm: Restore the official campaign? The current custom campaign will be deactivated.
campaign.progressCountHint: Counts files submitted for installation (including descriptors and manifests), excluding game targets kept unchanged.
campaign.libraryInstalled: Campaign library import succeeded. Game maps are written when activated.
campaign.extractionHint: Extracting selected entries in one batch to isolated staging. Installation and commit follow extraction.
campaign.defaultOverwriteHint: Conflicting files default to overwrite. Apply a choice to all files or switch individual files to keep.
campaign.autoDetectedHint: Available only when neither package.json nor metadata.txt is found. The campaign type is inferred from the standard layout and its name from the folder or source filename. Unknown author/version information is not guessed. Import uses the SCNexus library; game resources are written on activation.
campaign.diagnostic.AUTO_DESCRIPTOR_PRES: A descriptor is present; automatic recognition is unavailable
campaign.diagnostic.AUTO_LAYOUT_AMBIGUOU: Resource layout is ambiguous or contains multiple package roots
campaign.diagnostic.AUTO_LAYOUT_UNSUPPOR: Resources do not follow the standard Maps / Mods layout
campaign.diagnostic.AUTO_CAMPAIGN_AMBIGU: Multiple campaign types found; automatic recognition is unavailable
campaign.diagnostic.AUTO_CAMPAIGN_NOT_FO: No uniquely identifiable standard campaign map directory found
customize.title: Custom content
customize.installedHint: The content is installed directly into the game directory. No activation is needed.
customize.directInstall: Installs directly into game Maps / Mods. The management directory stores only metadata and a manifest, not another full resource copy.
customize.autoDetectedHint: Available only when no package.json is found. Generates a plan from standard Maps / Mods under one package root. metadata.txt is not custom-content metadata; unknown author and version are not guessed.
customize.empty: No custom content installed. Select an archive or folder to install, or scan the game directory.
customize.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall this content? Game files written by it and its management manifest will be removed. Local files you chose to keep are not deleted; shared files require an explicit choice.
customize.descriptorPresent: A package.json is present; automatic recognition is unavailable
content.typeConflictHint: package.json and metadata.txt specify different content types. Choose a descriptor to analyze again. Nothing will be installed automatically or silently ignored.
content.classifying: Reading descriptors and directory layout to identify content type…
